study_design: Retrospective case-control study with two control series
reason: The abstract compares prostate cancer patients with controls and reports associations with prostate cancer risk. It does not analyze aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Regardless of the control group, risk of prostate cancer gained with increases in ingestion of retinoids, animal fats, and vitamin C.
estimate_classifications.reason: This is an association between vitamin C intake and overall prostate cancer risk, with no aggressive disease definition.
